description: QOBLIB cross-verification and QUBO analysis output schema

num_constraints.description: Number of constraint rows in the instance

rust_checker_built.description: Whether the Rust reference checker compiled successfully

candidates.description: Map from solution filename to verification result

valid.description: Whether the solution satisfies all constraints (Ax = b)

ones_count.description: Number of variables set to 1 in the solution

rust_exit_code.description: Exit code from the Rust reference checker (0=valid, 1=invalid)

qubo_objective.description: QUBO penalty objective value; 0 iff feasible

dimension.description: Number of binary variables (matrix side length)

num_nonzero.description: Number of non-zero entries in the upper-triangular QUBO matrix (including diagonal)

min_coefficient.description: Minimum non-zero coefficient in the QUBO matrix

max_coefficient.description: Maximum non-zero coefficient in the QUBO matrix

constant_offset.description: Constant term b^T b from the penalty expansion

num_nodes.description: Number of nodes in the instance graph

num_edges.description: Number of edges in the instance graph

candidates.description: Map from solution filename to verification result

valid.description: Whether the proposed set is independent (no adjacent pair)

set_size.description: Number of nodes in the proposed set

instance_name.description: NAME field from the TSPLIB instance file

num_customers.description: Number of customers (DIMENSION minus 1 for the depot)

candidates.description: Map from solution filename to verification result

valid.description: Whether all customers are served exactly once and no route exceeds capacity

num_routes.description: Number of routes in the solution

total_cost.description: Sum of all route costs using EUC_2D distances

max_route_load.description: Maximum total demand across all routes

required_nodes.description: Required number of nodes from instance specification

required_max_degree.description: Required maximum degree from instance specification

candidates.description: Map from graph filename to verification result

valid.description: Whether graph meets required node count, max degree, and is connected

num_nodes.description: Number of nodes in the graph

num_edges.description: Number of edges in the graph

max_degree.description: Maximum node degree in the graph

diameter.description: Graph diameter (longest shortest path); -1 if disconnected
